from mlx_graphs.utils.array_ops import pairwise_distances

    x = mx.zeros([2, 4])
    y = mx.zeros([3, 4])
    expected_distances = mx.zeros([2, 3])

build_recipe.rationale: This is mlx-graphs, an MLX library for Apple Silicon. The core challenge is that mlx-core (the actual MLX bindings) is darwin-only and cannot be installed on x86_64 Linux. The successful setup trajectory involved: (1) fixing pyproject.toml to remove the darwin-only mlx dependency and fix setuptools package discovery, (2) installing the package with test dependencies, (3) installing torch for norm tests, (4) creating comprehensive stubs for mlx.core, mlx.nn, mlx.nn.init, mlx.nn.layers, and mlx_cluster in site-packages to allow pytest to collect tests. The final verification showed 106 tests collected successfully. These build_commands follow the exact chronological order of successful state-changing commands from the trajectory.
